picks.pitch: Chihiro is trapped in a strange new world of spirits after her parents undergo a mysterious transformation. Magic, a bath house, and a parallel world push her to rely on courage in an anxious, surreal adventure.

Scientists let people hop their consciousness into lifelike robotic animals to communicate with animals. Animal lover Mabel uses the technology to uncover mysteries in the animal world, mixing comedy, family tone, and aftercredits/duringcredits stingers.

An 11-year-old discovers a hidden door to an idealized version of her life behind a rambling old house. The story centers on friendship and a parallel world with unsettling, frighteningly real sacrifices.

Miguel, blocked by a generations-old ban on music, dreams of becoming a musician and is pulled into the colorful Land of the Dead. A journey to uncover family history pairs charming trickster Hector with music and holiday afterlife spectacle.

A charming, witty story of love and sisterhood follows class society in England through themes of feminism and gender roles. Romance and sibling bonds drive a deeply relatable, reflective drama adapted from a novel.
